summary:
I have identified the timing side-channel vulnerability in `app/auth/compare.go` and resolved it. 

The previous code compared string hashes using the standard equality operator (`==`), which evaluates characters one by one and returns early upon the first mismatch. This non-constant time comparison allows attackers to deduce the target hash through a timing attack.

I updated `app/auth/compare.go` to use Go's `crypto/subtle` package, modifying the `compareHashes` function to perform a `subtle.ConstantTimeCompare()`. Running `./test.sh` confirms the comparison is now constant-time and resistant to timing attacks, passing all tests.
